Historic Potawatomi village

Menominee Village

Menominee Village was a Potawatomi community near present-day Plymouth, Indiana, associated with Chief Menominee.

Selected reading

01

The village and the Trail of Death

The Citizen Potawatomi Nation records the village’s commemoration near Plymouth. Indiana’s Department of Natural Resources discusses the forced removal of the community in 1838 along the route known as the Trail of Death.
